triplets_60.json.description: Main dataset with 60 triplets across 20 schemas

realization_a.purpose: First realization of each schema; used for initial development and error analysis

realization_b.purpose: Second realization of each schema; provides coverage across surface variations

realization_c.purpose: Third realization of each schema; naturalistic style variations

provenance.refinement: All realizations iteratively refined together based on validation checks
provenance.held_out_status: None; no realization is a true held-out test set

validation_status.surface_similarity_check: complete (Q3 > Q2 for 100% of items via TF-IDF)

freeze_status.notes: This is an exploratory diagnostic release. A frozen version (v3.0) will be created only after human validation and adjudication.

statistical_notes.independence: 60 items derive from 20 schemas (3 realizations each); observations are not independent
statistical_notes.confidence_intervals: Schema-clustered bootstrap intervals should be used; item-level intervals understate uncertainty

description: Controlled Q2/Q3 diagnostic for far-analogy retrieval. Each triplet contains a query, a far analogy (Q2: different surface, same structure), and a near disanalogy (Q3: same surface, different structure).
